segments.text: kimja iser, another thing for such a yogi is that loka ananda samadhisukham.
The joy of his samadhi, the joy, whatever he feels in the state of samadhi,
he said to be injection for the whole universe, injection of ananda.
He has not to speak in words, he has not to give lectures or talk.
Just he has to remain in samadhi and that will carry the whole universe in samadhi.
In that supreme bliss.
loka he has explained in two ways.
Whatever is perceived is loka and the perceiver too is also loka.
Persever, perceived and perceiver, both are said to be loka.
loka ithe loka, loka ithe ithe loka, loka ithe that one who perceives,
who is the perceiver of everybody is loka and the object that is perceived is loka.
In both ways it should be explained loka.
Tasmin svarati sati, when objective world and subjective world are simultaneously in movement.
Tasmin svarati sati, when objective world and subjective world are in movement together.
Then what happens?
Grahe, Grahaka, Samviti, Samanya, Sarvadehna.
All other individual beings perceive the objective world, separate from subjective world and subjective world,
separate from objective world.
But there is exception for yogis, visesha, special exception.
Sambandhi, Savadehna, and the perceiving of objective world, they perceive,
subjective world, in-objective world and subjective world, in-subjective world.
Objective world and subjective world do not at least differ from each other,
there in his consciousness because his subjective god consciousness is held everywhere in objective world also.
That is Savadehna. Savadehna means awareness of god consciousness is said to him everywhere.
This is what we can do with God consciousness.
According to these sayings, such sayings of God consciousness,
Paramatrapadevishranth, Avdhan, Antashchamatkar, Mayo, Yahananda,
when he resides in this state of subjectivity with full awareness and with full joy of experience in his own nature.
This is what Sambandhi says.
This is said to be the joy of his Sambandhi.
The same is quoted in Vijayanabhairava.
Sarvam Jagat, Sadehava, Swananda, Baritam, Sumri, Yugupat.
When simultaneously, Yugupat, simultaneously, Yogi meditates on the whole universe
or in his body, the fullness of supreme joy of self,
Swananda, Baritam, Sarvam Jagat, Sadehava, the one who feels and perceives that the whole universe or his body is filled with supreme bliss of joy,
simultaneously. Then by the flow of that joy, he becomes one with supreme joy.
This is narrated in Sbandha, in this Shloka.
Yamaeva Amrita Prathi, this is said to be the achievement of a real nectar, supreme Amrita.
There is another way of its explanation done by masters, and that is as follows.
Yatasiya Swatmarama siya Samadhi Sukham.
Whenever this Swatmarama, Swatmarama is the Yogi who is always residing in his own self.
Naturally, he enjoys the bliss of Samadhi.
When he is introverted, situated and established in his own self, Tadev Tattad Rasam, Avalogya Dham Lokana,
anybody who thinks at that moment, anybody who thinks that he is situated in Samadhi, he is enjoying the bliss of Samadhi.
He too will enter in Samadhi. At that very moment, just like Vajangavat, Garalesankrama,
just like a cobra, when you see cobra, not from distance, face to face, when you see cobra,
and that poison will enter in you and you will be filled with that poison.
In the same way, the one who is established in the joy of Samadhi,
and you feel that he is enjoying the joy of Samadhi, you will also enjoy the joy of Samadhi at once.
So this is Yatasiya Samadhi Sukham, saver Lokana.
It proves in bestowing Ahananda to everybody, the whole world.
But how, how he enters in that? Ahananda Sankramana Yuktya, that Ahananda penetrates in his nature,
that Ahananda of the Tiyogi penetrates in the nature who sees and feels that he is in Ahananda.
So, Ahananda abhivakti pariyosaai bhavti. So, he too becomes one with that Ahananda.
Abhrapali.
Aetata bhi suvi Chandragyana Granthena, Prahukthena, Susumvadam.
Chandragyana Grantha, the coating of Chandragyana Grantha, which is already coated beforehand.
You should see that Chandragyana Grantha also has animated the same way of the explanation
of this Lokana and the Samadhi Sukham.
